cohort: Previously registered ordinary TRAIN recording panel
weights: Published v1, frozen source-specific epoch100, prepared front end, and two-round four-reference decoder
metrics: Strict oriented 3D IoU > 0.25 and > 0.50 and mean IoU, six directions equally weighted
seal: Verify every prediction block before any grounding-label read. Independent CPU geometry computes the same physical boxes with a 3D convex hull.
selection: No result-dependent arms or changes to the registered main method

arms.frozen_text: Native frozen 3EED first-noun text score and axis-aligned model-frame box; label-free same-input reference.
arms.direct: Choose the first subject anchor with its PCA yaw. Same front end, boxes, and ranking inputs.
arms.no_rgb: Disconnect early and late RGB feature paths by neutral pixels and invalid 2D correspondence edges. Recompute the native point adapter and competition route with the same camera geometry.
arms.no_competition: Use the original RGB-enhanced front-end probabilities before its candidate-conditioned competition residual. Decoder remains intact.
arms.no_overlap_prior: Rank the subject anchors by the original front-end probabilities. Keep the four-slot IoU diversity rule.
arms.no_slot_diversity: Keep overlap-corrected utilities and use their plain top four.
arms.no_output_pca: Keep v1's winner and reset only its output yaw in model coordinates.
arms.no_anchor_pca: Reset the yaw of all subject and reference anchors before joint inference and use the selected unchanged-yaw anchor.
arms.no_reference_interaction: Keep both reads and subject geometric feedback. Disable reference-to-subject and subject-to-reference messages and final compatibility via the reference-availability mask.
arms.no_ref_to_subj: Zero the reference-to-subject message. Other reads and final compatibility remain.
arms.no_subj_to_ref: Zero the subject-to-reference message. Other reads and final compatibility remain.
arms.no_subject_geometry: Use the static anchor bias on the second read. Keep both messages and final compatibility.
arms.no_final_pair: Remove the final pair term, keeping pair-guided first-round messages.
arms.no_pair_projection: Zero the pair scoring function's projected offset and joint-visibility terms. Keep the projection in the slot reads and support statistics.
arms.no_predicate_vector: Remove the separate pooled predicate vector from the decoder. Keep the full expression and role spans.
